note.question: How does the multinomial logit model from sales transaction data affect demand estimation?
note.overview: A major task in retail operations is to optimize the assortments exhibited to consumers. To this end, retailers need to understand customers’ preferences for different products. This is particularly challenging when only sales and product-availability data are recorded, and not all products are displayed in all periods.
